title: Make-Up of the Retention Remittance
content:
Retention remittance — how the amount is made up (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)

On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the retention remittance is the remittance shortfall plus the clearing cushion plus four remittance charges (the wire receipt fee, the returned remittance fee, the release title search fee and the release recording charge), rounded half up to the cent and only at that last step; the shortfall is floored at 0.00 before the cushion and the charges are added.

**Remittance shortfall.** The required payoff amount the payoff case carries less the funds the case holds net of returns (every payoff funds receipt on the case less every payoff funds return on it), and never below 0.00.

**Cushion and charges.** The clearing cushion, the wire receipt fee and the returned remittance fee are each 0.00; the release title search fee is USD 40.00; and the release recording charge is USD 48.00 for one recorded instrument.

| Component | Amount |
|---|---|
| Remittance shortfall | required payoff amount less net funds held, not below 0.00 |
| Clearing cushion | 0.00 |
| Wire receipt fee | 0.00 |
| Returned remittance fee | 0.00 |
| Release title search fee | USD 40.00 |
| Release recording charge | USD 48.00 |

### Hypothetical figures

| Case | Required payoff amount | Net funds held | Shortfall | Retention remittance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | USD 175750.00 | USD 100000.00 | USD 75750.00 | USD 75838.00 |
| B | USD 90000.00 | USD 95000.00 | 0.00 | USD 88.00 |

In case B the funds already held exceed the required amount, so the shortfall is 0.00 and the remittance consists of the two release charges alone. Both cases are invented.
